body:
Iris N.: Hey team 9 just booted my Windows laptop. During OOBE I signed in with the corp account and Intune shows 'Enrolled', but BitLocker says 'Waiting for keys' and Control Panel shows 'BitLocker status: Off'. I can't access internal docs for my 10am onboarding. Any quick fixes?

IT Support: Welcome Iris! Can you open an elevated PowerShell and run `dsregcmd /status` and `manage-bde -status` and paste results? Also confirm Windows edition (Settings -> About).

Iris N.: dsregcmd: AzureAdJoined: YES, WorkplaceJoined: YES. manage-bde: OS drive Protection Off, TPM ready. Windows 11 Pro 22H2. I also see Company Portal app shows device as "Pending sync".

Maya (Onboarding): Sometimes Company Portal needs a user-initiated sync to escrow the recovery key. Open Company Portal -> Devices -> select this device -> Sync. If it refuses, try signing out/in of the app.

Iris N.: Did Sync, got 'Sync failed: 0x80180014' and then Company Portal asked me to sign in again. After signing in I see "Device compliance: Not evaluated".

IT Support: 0x80180014 often means Conditional Access blocked service-to-service because the device isn't fully compliant or there's a stale token. Quick workaround: we can push the BitLocker escrow from Intune console remotely after you run `manage-bde -on C: -usedefaultkey protector` as admin; that will enable BitLocker with TPM protector and Intune should pick up the recovery key on next device sync. Do not create a recovery password locally.

Iris N.: Ok running `manage-bde -on C: -usedefaultkey protector` now... it prompted for reboot and said encryption starting.

SecOps: Before you reboot, please confirm the device isn't using a personal Microsoft account. Conditional Access can block Company Portal token issuance if the SSO session is to a consumer account. Also make sure date/time is correct and there's no captive portal.

Iris N.: Confirmed corp SSO only, clock is correct, on office wifi with full internet. Rebooting now.

IT Support: After reboot, open Company Portal and trigger Sync again. If it still shows pending, we'll run a remote sync from the Intune portal and then check in Azure AD for the device's BitLockerKey.

Iris N.: Reboot done. Company Portal now shows "Sync succeeded" and manage-bde now shows "Protection On". I can see a policy notice: "Recovery key backup: pending".

IT Support: Initiated a remote sync and requested key escrow from Intune. Give it a minute and then check https://endpoint.microsoft.com -> Devices -> {your device} -> Recovery keys.

Iris N.: I see the recovery key listed in the portal now. Phew. Thanks.

Maya (Onboarding): Welcome to Redwood Inference, Iris! We'll close the temporary incident. If you need VPN certs or access to internal drives, ping me and I'll add you to the corp groups.

Iris N.: All good, joining the onboarding call now. Appreciate the speedy help!

onboarding-bot: Device registered and BitLocker recovery key escrow confirmed for Iris N. Welcome to Redwood Inference!"
